set.body:
robust=FALSE together with robust_options=list(type="huber") yields huber.
An explicit request to disable robust fitting is discarded without warning.

Verified:
  robust=FALSE, robust_options=list(type="huber")  -> type = "huber"
  robust=FALSE alone                               -> type = FALSE

8 of the 12 robust_options call sites also pass robust=, so this is reachable in
practice, not hypothetical.

Site: .fmri_lm_normalize_robust_options, R/fmrilm.R:254-284.

Note: the redesign makes this unrepresentable rather than fixed - a single
robust_spec(type=) field has nothing to conflict with. Fix in place first so the
current release is correct.
set.title: Fix: explicit robust=FALSE silently overridden by robust_options
